sources.snippet: SPECTER2 + Proximity Adapter (ONNX) This is an ONNX export of allenai/specter2_base with the proximity adapter fused in. It produces 768-dimensional embeddings optimized for scientific document similarity and citation prediction. The adapter weights are baked into the model graph — no separate adapter loading needed.
